type.title: Ask for a remake
type.body: Made to measure and it does not fit: tell us what is wrong and send a photo from the front and one from the back.
type.none: Nothing of this delivery can be remade now. You can still report a quality problem.
type.later: For a repair or alteration or a safety incident, write to {sender} directly for now.

item.hint: One item, one piece: the one that does not fit.
item.none: Nothing of this delivery can be remade now.
item.noneBody: Every piece is on another request already, or none was delivered yet. For news, ask {sender}.

details.fit: What is wrong with the fit
details.fitHint: Where it pulls, is too long or too short, and by how much (for example: the sleeves are 3 cm too long).

photos.intro: We need two photos of you wearing it: one from the front and one from the back, standing straight.
photos.needed: A photo from the front and one from the back: {count} of {needed} added.

check.item: Pick the item to make again.
check.fit: Say what is wrong with the fit.
check.photos_one: Add {count} more photo: a remake needs one from the front and one from the back.
check.photos_other: Add {count} more photos: a remake needs one from the front and one from the back.

done.title: Remake request {number} sent
done.next: We look at the photos and what you told us, and tell you how we make it again and whether to send the garment back.

portal.typeBody: Made to measure and it does not fit: tell us what is wrong; the photos from the front and the back follow on the request.
portal.itemHint: One item, one piece: the one that does not fit.
portal.none: Nothing we delivered can be remade now.
portal.noneBody: Every piece is on another request already. Ask a question in the messages if you need more.
portal.fit: What is wrong with the fit
portal.fitHint: Where it pulls, is too long or too short, and by how much (for example: the sleeves are 3 cm too long).
portal.photosNext: Once it is sent, add a photo of you wearing it from the front and one from the back on the request.
portal.sentPhotos: Now add the two photos (from the front and from the back) on the request.
portal.sentNext: We look at the photos and what you told us, and tell you how we make it again.
portal.openRequest: Open the request to add the photos

problem.item: Pick the item to make again.
problem.itemGone: This item can no longer be remade: pick another.
problem.nothing: Nothing we delivered can be remade now.
problem.fit: Say what is wrong with the fit.
